title: Hum Najaf Aagaye
body:
Ali Ali Ali Ali Ali Ali Ali...
Ali Ali Ali Ali Ali Ali Ali...
Hajat Rawa,n Hai Mushkil Kusha Shre Khuda Hai Mere Moula...
Daste Jali Hai Haqqe Wali Hai Nafse Nabi Hai Mere Moula...
Moula...Moula...Moula...Moula...
Moula...Moula...Moula...Moula...
Ham Najaf Aagaye Aur Kia Chahiye...
Aey Khuda e Ali (As) Bs Qaza Chahiye...
1) La Maka,n Ke Maka,n Ka Makee,n Aagaya...
Aey Buto,n Ghar Naya Dhundna Chahiye...
2)Turr Par To Nahi Ham Ko Musa Miley...
Ab Najaf Unhe Dhundna Chahiye...
3) Aey Khuda Sirf Chalees Ghar Ko Nahi...
Sari Duniya Ko Hi Murtaza Chahiye...
4) Jab Se Ka'aba Bana Tab Se Zid Uski Thi...
Murtaza Chahiye Murtaza Chahiye...
Kiya Batau Ali (As) Ki Shan Hai Kia...
Rab Ke Jesi Meri Saban Hai Kia
Ham Dare Murtaza Pey Bethey Hai
Is Se Behtar Koyi Amaan Hai Kia
Ham Najaf Tak Ka Kar Chukey Hai Safar
Is Se Aagey Bhi Aasmaan Hai Kia
Ham Najaf Aagaya Aur Kia Chahiye...
5) Ayse Kaise Samjh Aayegey Murtaza...
Aey Muqassir Bada Housla Chahiye...
6) Ham Se Kiyu Chanda Masjid Ka Letey Ho Tum...
Bas Khuda Se Agar Mangna Chahiye...
7) Bole Asghar Ye Hanstey Hue Baap Se...
Ab Khiloney Nahi Hurmala Chahiye...
8) Padh Ke SAJJAD Tasbeehe Zehra (Sa) Kaho...
Ya Ali (As) Aapse Mashwara Chahiye...
